newsitem.title: MEXICO: Vitro to receive payment on senior notes.
newsitem.headline: Vitro to receive payment on senior notes.

text.p: Industrial conglomerate Vitro S.A. will receive the funds this week from the senior note issues of its subsidiary Vitro Capital Corporation (Vicap), a company director said on Monday.
The amount was increased to $425 million from the originally planned $350 million.
The funds will be used to subsitute for peso denominated debt, said corporate financing director Jaime Garcia.
"After this operation a third of the Vitro debt will be denominated in pesos, and two thirds will be in dollars, while before it was 60 percent in pesos and 40 percent in dollars," he said.
On May 7, the company placed note worth $175 million with a coupon of 10.25 percent, maturing in 2002. Another $250 million with a rate of 11.375 percent will mature in 2007.
The notes will be guaranteed by Vitro.
